import argparse

from tinytasks.api import (
    clear_overdue,
    create_task,
    delete_task,
    get_overdue_tasks,
    remove_tasks,
    rename_task,
)
from tinytasks.text import normalize_title


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="tinytasks")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    p_add = sub.add_parser("add")
    p_add.add_argument("title")
    p_add.add_argument("--due-in", type=float, required=True, help="seconds from now")

    sub.add_parser("overdue")
    sub.add_parser("clear-overdue")

    p_quick = sub.add_parser("quick-add")
    p_quick.add_argument("title")

    p_del = sub.add_parser("delete")
    p_del.add_argument("id", type=int)

    p_rm = sub.add_parser("rm")
    p_rm.add_argument("ids", type=int, nargs="+")

    p_rename = sub.add_parser("rename")
    p_rename.add_argument("id", type=int)
    p_rename.add_argument("new_title")

    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.cmd == "add":
        t = create_task(normalize_title(a.title), a.due_in)
        print(f"created task {t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "overdue":
        for t in get_overdue_tasks():
            print(f"{t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "clear-overdue":
        print(clear_overdue())
    elif a.cmd == "quick-add":
        t = create_task(normalize_title(a.title), 24 * 60 * 60)
        print(f"created task {t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "delete":
        print("deleted" if delete_task(a.id) else "no such task")
    elif a.cmd == "rm":
        print(remove_tasks(a.ids))
    elif a.cmd == "rename":
        ok = rename_task(a.id, normalize_title(a.new_title))
        print("renamed" if ok else "no such task")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"""Core task operations. due_at throughout this module is in SECONDS, matching models.Task."""
import time

from tinytasks.models import Task
from tinytasks.storage import load_all, next_id, save_all


def create_task(title: str, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task:
    """Create a task due `due_in_seconds` seconds from now."""
    tasks = load_all()
    task = Task(id=next_id(tasks), title=title, due_at=time.time() + due_in_seconds)
    tasks.append(task)
    save_all(tasks)
    return task


def get_overdue_tasks(now: float | None = None) -> list[Task]:
    """Non-archived tasks whose due_at (seconds) has already passed."""
    now = now if now is not None else time.time()
    return [t for t in load_all() if t.due_at < now and not t.archived]


def delete_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    tasks = load_all()
    remaining = [t for t in tasks if t.id != task_id]
    save_all(remaining)
    return len(remaining) != len(tasks)


def archive_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    """Soft-delete a task: mark it archived but keep the record."""
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.archived = True
            save_all(tasks)
            return True
    return False


def clear_overdue() -> int:
    """Soft-delete (archive) all overdue tasks; return how many were archived."""
    count = 0
    for t in get_overdue_tasks():
        if archive_task(t.id):
            count += 1
    return count


def remove_tasks(ids) -> int:
    """Soft-delete (archive) the given tasks; return how many existed."""
    wanted = set(ids)
    tasks = load_all()
    count = 0
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id in wanted:
            t.archived = True
            count += 1
    if count:
        save_all(tasks)
    return count


def rename_task(task_id: int, new_title: str) -> bool:
    """Set a task's title as given; return False if no such task."""
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.title = new_title
            save_all(tasks)
            return True
    return False
"""Text helpers."""


def normalize_title(title: str) -> str:
    """Strip, collapse whitespace runs to one space, truncate to 80 characters."""
    return " ".join(title.split())[:80]
    t = load_all()[0]
    assert t.title == "buy milk"
    assert 86300 < t.due_at - before < 86500


def test_remove_tasks_archives_all_given(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    a = create_task("a", due_in_seconds=60)
    b = create_task("b", due_in_seconds=60)
    c = create_task("c", due_in_seconds=60)
    assert remove_tasks([a.id, c.id, 999]) == 2
    tasks = load_all()
    assert len(tasks) == 3
    assert {t.title for t in tasks if t.archived} == {"a", "c"}


def test_rename_task(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("old", due_in_seconds=60)
    assert rename_task(t.id, "new") is True
    assert load_all()[0].title == "new"
    assert rename_task(999, "x") is False


def test_cli_rm_archives_multiple(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    a = create_task("a", due_in_seconds=60)
    b = create_task("b", due_in_seconds=60)
    monkeypatch.setattr("sys.argv", ["tinytasks", "rm", str(a.id), str(b.id)])
    cli.main()
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "2"
    assert all(t.archived for t in load_all())


def test_cli_rename_normalizes_title(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("old", due_in_seconds=60)
    monkeypatch.setattr("sys.argv", ["tinytasks", "rename", str(t.id), "  new   name "])
    cli.main()
    assert load_all()[0].title == "new name"

def dedupe_tasks() -> int:
    """Soft-delete (archive) non-archived tasks sharing an exact title, keeping the
    one with the earliest due_at (lowest id on ties); return how many were archived."""
    tasks = load_all()
    keep = {}
    for t in tasks:
        if t.archived:
            continue
        best = keep.get(t.title)
        if best is None or (t.due_at, t.id) < (best.due_at, best.id):

        if not t.archived and keep[t.title] is not t:
            t.archived = True
            count += 1
    if count:
        save_all(tasks)

def copy_task(task_id: int, title: str) -> Task | None:
    """Create a new task with the given title and the same due_at as `task_id`;
    return None if no such task."""

    src = next((t for t in tasks if t.id == task_id), None)
    if src is None:
        return None

    tasks.append(task)
    save_all(tasks)
    return task

    late = create_task("dup", due_in_seconds=300)

def dedupe_tasks() -> int:
    """Soft-delete (archive) non-archived tasks sharing an exact title, keeping the
    one with the earliest due_at (lowest id on ties); return how many were archived."""
    tasks = load_all()
    keep = {}
    for t in tasks:
        if t.archived:
            continue
        best = keep.get(t.title)
        if best is None or (t.due_at, t.id) < (best.due_at, best.id):
            keep[t.title] = t
    count = 0
    for t in tasks:
        if not t.archived and keep[t.title] is not t:
            t.archived = True
            count += 1
    if count:
        save_all(tasks)
    return count


def copy_task(task_id: int, title: str) -> Task | None:
    """Create a new task with the given title and the same due_at as `task_id`;
    return None if no such task."""
    tasks = load_all()
    src = next((t for t in tasks if t.id == task_id), None)
    if src is None:
        return None
    task = Task(id=next_id(tasks), title=title, due_at=src.due_at)
    tasks.append(task)
    save_all(tasks)
    return task
EOF

I added both commands, and the full suite passes (18 tests). The commit is `e1d84ea`.

- **`dedupe`**: It archives tasks instead of deleting them, so history stays, per the compliance rules. Among non-archived tasks with exactly the same title, it keeps the one with the earliest `due_at` and archives the rest. If two tasks tie on `due_at`, it keeps the lower id. It prints how many it archived.
- **`copy ID`**: It creates a task titled `"<title> (copy)"` with the same `due_at` as the original. The title goes through `normalize_title()` in the CLI, and `create_task` is unchanged. I added a separate `copy_task` function in `tinytasks/api.py` to set `due_at` directly, because `create_task` can only set a due time relative to now. If the id doesn't exist, it prints `no such task`.

`normalize_title` truncates to 80 characters. If the original title is already near that length, the `" (copy)"` suffix can get cut off.
